versions.subject: standardize rules with Image and CommandLine instead of NewProcessName and ProcessCommandLine
Updated Rules to Use OriginalFileName
versions.detection:
selection_img:
  Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
  OriginalFileName|contains: 'schtasks.exe'
selection_cli:
  CommandLine|contains|all:
    - '/change'
    - '/TN'
    - '/RU'
    - '/RP'
condition: all of selection*
